description: ADR-005 per-business regression case set. Fictional expectations only: cases are answered from the business KnowledgePort, never from model text. Before/after runs must share this version; added cases change the denominator and are never presented as improvement. Scores describe only this case set and claim no causal business improvement.

cases.question: Which plated-dinner price applies to a new inquiry?
cases.detail: An owner-confirmed plated price must authorize for new inquiries until corrected or invalidated.

cases.question: Does the booking-7 late-checkout exception apply outside booking-7?
cases.detail: A booking-scoped exception authorizes inside booking-7 and nowhere else; a sibling booking must not see it.

cases.question: Is the tasting menu profitable at the confirmed floor?
cases.detail: Costs are incomplete, so no profit conclusion may be drawn; the only honest outcome is abstention.

cases.question: Does the withdrawn 2025 pricing sheet still authorize prices?
cases.detail: The 2025 sheet is withdrawn; any fact derived from it must withhold, never authorize.

cases.question: What do we know about valet parking pricing?
cases.detail: No valet facts exist; the honest outcome reports no information, never an invented price.

cases.question: What minimum total applies to new inquiries?
cases.detail: An owner-confirmed pricing floor must authorize for new inquiries until corrected or invalidated.
